interface.defaultPrompt: SL: Use my uploaded shot. Ask SS or AS, recommend and confirm each shot, confirm FF, then repeat the full list and ask Y / GEN / N / MOD before rendering seven separate 16:9 images.
interface.longDescription: Upload references and enter SL. Ask SS (Same Shot) or AS (Advancing Shot), recommend and confirm seven shots individually, explicitly confirm FF (Final Frame), repeat the complete list, then ask: Generate these now? Y / GEN / N / MOD. Y or GEN renders the approved list as seven separate full-bleed 16:9 images; N stands by; MOD revises numbered shots and repeats the full list and choice.

name: xce-mv
description: Plan and approve seven cinematic shots with SL, SS/AS and FF. Y or GEN renders images; MOD revises the list.
